description: We are seven students and two mentors, Mr. Mathias and Mr. Umar Suleiman Baguda, passionate about technology, innovation, and problem-solving. Our members are Fatima Jafar Jafar, Ayomide Jaiyeola, Delight Ajewole, Samir Oyeshiji, Hauwa Mustapha Imam, and Hauwa Muhd Suleiman. We offer strong mentorship and room to grow. We’re looking for participants with coding, design, writing, or presentation skills and a collaborative attitude. Join us and let’s build something great
